## v1.9.5 — Nodes polish, theme icons, Add App CTA

Multi-node UX polish: the Nodes strip stays out of the way on single-host installs, Agents/Nodes live in Settings, docs cover Native / Docker / Unraid upgrades, and chrome icons change **style and glyph** when you switch themes.

Full guide: [Multi-node overview](https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/docs/multi-node/overview)

### Added

- **Settings → Infrastructure → Agents/Nodes** — live agent table, connection controls, and copy-paste env snippets
- **Multi-node docs** — dedicated section (overview, connect, platforms, TCP/TLS, controls, troubleshooting)
- **Theme icon styles** — five shared icon families (outline, bold-square, filled, duotone, pixel-geo) with per-theme glyph aliases so Settings/topbar icons change shape, not only color

### Changed

- **Nodes strip** — hidden unless two or more agents are online (single-host dashboards stay clean)
- **Add App** — larger primary CTA vs Settings / Sign Out
- **Release notes template** — every tag documents Native / Proxmox, Docker, and Unraid upgrade paths

### Upgrade

**Native / Proxmox**

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/download/v1.9.5/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Or, if you already have the updater locally: `./update-amud.sh`

**Docker**

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

Image: `tradmss/amud-dashboard:latest` (or pin `tradmss/amud-dashboard:v1.9.5`)

**Unraid**

1. Open **Apps** → installed **AMUD-Dashboard** (and **AMUD-Agent** if used).
2. **Check for Updates** → apply / recreate the container(s).
3. Hard-refresh the browser (Ctrl+Shift+R). For remote agents, keep `network_mode: host` and matching `AMUD_AGENT_SECRET` / `AMUD_NODE_TAG`.

Hard-refresh your browser after updating if you use the PWA. Existing single-host setups keep working unchanged.

**Recommended:** `v1.9.5`  
**Rollback:** reinstall / pin `v1.9.4` if anything misbehaves.

**Binaries:** `amud-server`, `amud-agent` (amd64 + arm64), `ui.tar.gz`, and `SHA256SUMS` are attached below.
